title: Albert Einstein: Relativity's Genius
description: Relativity, awards, and the mind that reimagined the cosmos.

questions.question: Who developed the theory of relativity?
What is Einstein's most famous equation?
Fame from E=mc² aside, Einstein's Nobel Prize honored what effect?
That photoelectric effect work earned Einstein the Nobel in what year?
questions.explanation: It was the 1921 prize—but the committee held it over and handed it to him in 1922, so both years show up in the record books.

questions.question: After his 1921 Nobel, Einstein fled Germany and spent his last 22 years at what research institute in Princeton?
questions.explanation: Common mix-up: he was never a Princeton University professor. The Institute for Advanced Study sits nearby and was independent of the university.

imageHint: Wild hair and equations that bent spacetime
